chunks: From him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Nawfali, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:
“The wounds of slaves are assessed in accordance with the wounds of free persons, in proportion to the price.”

key_terms.الثَّمَنِ: the price or monetary value by which compensation is measured here
key_terms.الْأَحْرَارِ: free persons whose injury rulings form the basis of comparison
key_terms.الْعَبِيدِ: slaves; enslaved persons subject to legal valuation in this ruling
key_terms.جِرَاحَاتُ: wounds or injuries for which compensation is assessed
key_terms.عَلَى نَحْوِ: according to the manner or pattern of

ai.seo_question: How are injuries to slaves compensated in Shia hadith law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning compensation for injuries inflicted upon slaves. It states that their wounds are evaluated according to the same pattern as the wounds of free persons, but with consideration of their monetary value.
